observations: Photo 0 shows a dry pressing iron (no water tank visible) with a white/grey soleplate and a damaged-looking power cord near the plug end.
The plug and cord insulation appear worn/frayed in the photo.
No brand/model label is readable in the photo.
No clear view of thermostat dial, steam vents (none visible), or any working indicator.

claims.claim: A used dry pressing iron that is still working is available for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show it being switched on or any test result; cord damage is visible, which could affect operation.

risks.risk: Power cord/plug damage could cause it to not work safely (shorting, intermittent power, or shock risk).
risks.proof: A short video of the iron plugged in and heating (showing power on and the soleplate warming) plus a close-up of the plug and cord insulation with no exposed wires.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not working / needs repair due to visible cord wear.

risks.risk: Soleplate condition (scratches/burn marks) could affect ironing performance and heat distribution.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the soleplate surface (especially the tip and edges) in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as average-wear used (no premium for condition).

risks.risk: Thermostat/heating element may be faulty even if the cord is okay.
risks.proof: Video showing temperature control working (e.g., dial changes and soleplate heat changes) or an IR thermometer reading over 1–2 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not guaranteed working.

proof_requests: Send a video of the iron plugged in and switched on until the soleplate warms (ideally 1–2 minutes).
Send a close-up photo of the plug and the entire cord length showing no exposed wires or cuts.
Show the thermostat/dial and confirm it changes heat level (video or thermometer reading).
response.reason: The seller claims it is working, but the photo shows visible cord/plug wear and there is no proof of operation. Until it’s tested on and the cord condition is confirmed, it should be treated as not reliably working for pricing.
